Questions business owners ask

I’m not technical. Can I still work with you?

Yes. Most of our clients aren’t. We explain everything in plain language and handle the technical work.

How much does a project cost?

It depends on scope. After a short call you’ll get a written quote with what’s included, so there are no surprises.

How long does a website or app take?

A business website typically takes a few weeks, an app longer. We give a firm timeline in the plan.

What does AI automation actually do for my business?

It handles repetitive tasks like answering common questions, saving leads and sending reminders, so your team can focus on customers.

Do you work with businesses outside the big cities?

Yes. We work with businesses across India, and calls and WhatsApp make distance easy.

Will I own my website and data?

Yes. Your domain, content and customer data belong to you.

Ready to build something that grows your business?

Tell us what you’re trying to do. We’ll reply with a clear next step, not a sales pitch.
